# COR071 `missing-class-default`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A `select type` construct has no `class default`.

## Why

A `select type` without `class default` silently skips every dynamic type it does not list: an
extension added later, or an unexpected argument, is ignored instead of reported. Add
`class default` with an error, unless ignoring the other types is the intent.

## Reported

```fortran
select type (q)
type is (real(R8P))
  call apply(q)
end select
```

## Preferred

```fortran
select type (q)
type is (real(R8P))
  call apply(q)
class default
  error stop 'unsupported type'
end select
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR071] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR071` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).
